title: Matt Lacey — Fifa's $20B commercial vehicle as 'a fascinating example of financial gravity at play'
summary: Matt Lacey — strategist and author of the Adventures in Strategy newsletter — picks up the Financial Times report on Fifa raising a $20B commercial vehicle to lure external investors and reads it through the Incorruptible frame: the rumored 64-team World Cup and every-two-years cadence are financial gravity showing up in real time, with Infantino and Trump family beneficiaries at the top.
blockquote: I recently read 'Incorruptable' by Eric Ries. (highly recommended) Who'd have thought Fifa could provide such a fascinating example of 'financial gravity' at play.
